testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/home-page/validate-featured-products-visibility-count-and-navigation.spec.ts > Webstore - Home Page > validate featured products visibility, count and navigation

scenario.summary: Guest opens the home page, checks the 'Featured Product' heading and that each of the four featured product cards (by SKU, in widget order) is visible, checks the Featured Categories heading and the five featured category names, opens the Plumbing featured category and checks its heading, the default 'Showing 16 of 32 Results' summary, then sets page size 12 and checks 'Showing 12 of 32 Results' and that the scrolled product count is unchanged. Read-only.
steps: Open the webstore home as a guest (empty storageState) and scroll to Featured Products.
For each SKU in featuredProductList check the card [id$='-<sku>'] is visible.
Scroll to Featured Categories; check the heading and each name in featuredCategoriesList (p[data-test-selector^='txtCategoryName']); check the 'Electrical' label text.
Open the 'Plumbing' featured category card; check the category heading.
Check hdgShowingResults 'Showing 16 of 32 Results'; count all products by scrolling.
Set page size 12; check 'Showing 12 of 32 Results'; count again and compare with the first count.
assertions: Featured Product heading text is 'Featured Product' (fixed UI text).
Each featured product SKU card is visible (4 SKUs).
Featured Categories heading and each of the 5 featured category names are visible; the Electrical label reads 'Electrical'.
The opened category's heading is its name (Plumbing).
'Showing 16 of 32 Results' at the default page size and 'Showing 12 of 32 Results' at page size 12 (32 = products listed in the category).
Scrolled product count after the page-size change equals the count before.
evidence: Title 'validate featured products visibility, count and navigation' and the five step labels match the flow; guest storageState; data file read through loadData; no linked AIO cases.
Profile (2026-11-01): every value is NO_RULE (profiled false).
Store MaxwellsHardware: the store every migrated webstore spec runs on; not named in the scan.
